heading: Aviation English
intro: ICAO English Language Proficiency testing for pilots and air traffic controllers — plus focused test preparation.
accred-text: Recognised Test Centre & registered Aviation Training Organisation
intro2-heading: Language proficiency and safety — one and the same
intro2-p1: Safety in aviation means accuracy and good use of language. Clear communication is a requirement for flight crew and Air Traffic Controllers, who must show a minimum acceptable level of English through a proficiency test.
intro2-p2: The test is a standardised oral assessment measuring speaking ability in the context of aviation operations, and the ability to listen to pilot / ATC exchanges in live interaction.
criteria-heading: Assessed against the six ICAO criteria
levels-footnote: A Level 4 requires meeting all six criteria at Level 4 — effective voice-only and face-to-face communication, clarity on work-related topics, and handling unexpected situations.
test-intro: With a Subject Matter Expert (a pilot) plus a language expert assessing:
test-list: Your experience and interest in aviation
Questions on aviation operations and procedures
Describing an emergency-situation picture and speculating on causes
Listening to radio exchanges and answering questions
prepare-text: General English courses plus focused test preparation. Candidates at Upper-Intermediate level in IH English courses can prepare themselves for the test.
